subject: Post-call: Private hosting constraints & technical deep-dive scheduling
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Emma Jones <emma.jones@stellarishealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 14 Nov 2026 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call recap & initial ask — private hosting constraints

Emma — thanks again for the time earlier. Quick recap from today's discovery and proposed next steps so we can align engineering and procurement: 

Summary of pain / goals
- Primary driver: regulatory requirement to keep PHI/text-derived metadata inside US-only environments and eliminate uncontrolled egress (air-gap-like constraints).
- Performance: they need inference latencies ~200ms p95 for common endpoints (50–100 req/s pilot).
- Economics: prefer a Dedicated or Private deployment with reserved capacity and predictable pricing.

Key technical constraints you mentioned
- No direct outbound traffic to the public internet from model hosts (all outbound must go through a customer-managed proxy).
- Strict ingress rules: only source IP ranges from Stellaris VPCs and on-prem VPNs.
- KMS/HSM required for encryption key custody (FIPS/HSM preferred).
- Audit/log retention: 7 years with tamper-evidence; support for streaming logs to your SIEM.

Immediate asks / next artifacts we need from your side
1) Network diagram (VLANs, proxy, VPN endpoints) — earliest draft attached as "stellaris_network_outline_v1.pdf" if you have it.
2) Security questionnaire owner and expected turnaround for SOC2 / penetration test evidence.
3) Target procurement date — you mentioned mid-December; please confirm final internal sign-off date.

Proposed next steps
- Technical deep-dive with our solutions engineer (Marissa) and infra (Ben) to validate egress/proxy behavior and HSM integration. Can we target the week of Nov 22?
- We'll prepare a short technical readout (network checklist + minimal port/IP requirements) for your infra team.
- I'll log the items in the HubSpot record and share the materials with procurement.

Attachments: stellaris_discovery_notes.pdf, call_recording_20261114.mp3

Thanks — Rishi
Rishi Malhotra

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 09:10:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & initial ask — private hosting constraints

Rishi / Ben — quick engineering read on the items Emma called out.

- Air-gap vs. proxy: if stellaris allows a managed outbound proxy with strict allowlist (TLS inspection disabled for vendor certs) we can avoid a fully offline air-gapped install. That reduces operational complexity.
- Ports: we'll need to confirm whether the proxy supports long-lived TLS connections for our control plane and KV cache updates (recommended port 443).
- HSM/KMS: we integrate with external KMS via TLS — need to know if Stellaris requires an HSM in their network or if a cloud KMS with customer-controlled keys (bring-your-own-key) behind the proxy is acceptable.
- Logs: our runtime can stream audit logs to an internal endpoint over TLS; does Stellaris require a pull model into their SIEM?

Action items for next call
- Rishi: confirm if they can share the network diagram AND a sample firewall policy (IP ranges + ports).
- Ben: I'll draft a short list of minimal egress/connectivity checks (5 bullet checklist).

On Nov 14 Rishi wrote:
> Emma — thanks again for the time earlier. Quick recap from today's discovery and proposed next steps so we can align engineering and procurement: ...

—Marissa

Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 11:46:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & initial ask — private hosting constraints

Rishi — thanks for the summary, that matches what we discussed. A few clarifications and I attached the network outline (stellaris_network_outline_v1.pdf):

Clarifications
- Fully air-gapped is ideal but not mandatory for pilot — we can support an outbound-only proxy that allows TLS to specific vendor endpoints (we will manage the proxy).
- Allowed outbound: NTP, LDAP (for auth), and a small set of vendor update endpoints (quarterly). All other outbound traffic must be blocked.
- Key management: we plan to use our on-prem HSM; we can provide HSM endpoints and certs.
- Audit logs: we want push to our SIEM (Splunk) over a customer-only TLS endpoint; retention policy is 7 years.

Timeline
- Procurement window: target internal PO and contract signature by 2026-12-15.
- Pilot goal: Q1 2027 (limited production for a subset of workloads).

Attachments: stellaris_network_outline_v1.pdf (network ranges and proxy details).

I'll loop procurement and Rajiv (security) into next steps — Rajiv is the security lead and will expect a tech deep-dive with Marissa/Ben.

Please propose times for the technical deep-dive (Nov 22–26 preferred).

Best,
Emma Jones
